column8: Original pixel art in code at 3x world resolution: clonk with 12 animation frames per team (hat, belt, boots, face, shovel), waving flag, timber foundry with lit furnace, elevator, dynamite, 5 chunk types, grass tufts, particles

Chiselled edge lighting, point lights, grass, and the cumulus sky - generated in the fragment shader. Wood, leaves and structure are still drawn procedurally; the landscape materials come from the row below

column7: Resized 512x512 to 192x192 (Lanczos); blended 70% towards greyscale and normalised to a mid-grey mean, so each works as a pattern that modulates a material colour; stacked into one vertical strip of 8 layers; JPEG q92.
